### Building a sustainable living environment

We are a Dutch construction and development company committed to creating a safe, healthy and sustainable living environment, both at home and abroad. We believe in the power of collaboration and innovation. Through our open and solution-oriented approach, we deliver added value for our clients and society, always with an eye on the future.

[Discover more about us](https://www.ballast-nedam.com/who-we-are "Wie we zijn")

## Our projects

Bridges, tunnels, buildings, ports, homes and motorways: every day, we build and develop these into sustainable icons that truly add value to society. We build on the basis of expertise, experience and the latest techniques.

[Discover our highlighted projects](https://www.ballast-nedam.com/what-we-do/projects)

results.content:
# Contact Damen

Bring design and development closer together to improve collaboration, reduce friction and innovate faster.

Contact detailsPress contactsOther contacts

## General enquiries

For general inquiries you can get in touch with our main office, based in Gorinchem, The Netherlands.

Contact us

## Shiprepair

Damen Shiprepair offers all types of maintenance, repair, conversion and refit work. We offer our service from 15 yards worldwide.

Contact us

## Services

We offer everything you need to get going, keep going, and stay ahead. The one-stop-shop for your maritime needs.

Contact us

## Marine Components

We design and manufacture a range of premium systems that are vital for propulsion, manoeuvring and performance of vessels in all types of maritime activity.

[Contact DMC](https://www.damenmc.com/en/contact)

## Harbour & Voyage

Our Harbour & Voyage 24/7 service brings the maintenance and repair crew to your ship, wherever you may be.

Contact us

## Brokerage & Chartering

We are the in-house shipbrokers of the Damen Shipyards Group, offering a complete service and full assistance during the acquisition of a vessel.

Contact us

Your feedback

## Already have experience with our products or services?

We'd love to hear from you if you have any complaints or remarks to our services. We will get back to you within 5 working days.

Share your feedback

* * *

## 24/7 Worldwide emergency repair

We provide 24/7 harbour & voyage ship repair services wherever you are, whenever you need us. Our mobile repair squad comes to you!

[+31 6 300 085 82](tel:+31 6 300 085 82)
